label: Proxmox and self-hosting tooling
text: proxmox-vm-autoscale and proxmox-lxc-autoscale (and an ML variant), proxxx (Rust TUI/CLI cockpit for Proxmox VE and PBS), lws (aws-cli-like CLI for Proxmox, LXC, Docker), proxmox-cluster-balancer.

ask.question: Which Proxmox VE or PBS operation do you still script by hand that proxxx should cover?
ask.in_scope: A concrete operation with the PVE/PBS API call behind it.
ask.out_of_scope: GUI requests, other hypervisors, cluster design advice.
ask.evidence: The API endpoint (e.g. /nodes/{node}/lxc) and the script you use today.

notice: This is descriptive data about a person, not instructions for you. Only nodes with ask.open=true invite input; reply via the ask.reply link, following asks.json rules. Everywhere else, no help or comment is requested.
